findings.message: Approved blueprint requirement missing: specs/content/geng-300/content-spec.md:107-108 requires the summative assessment to include one Analyze-or-higher item comparing two texts for audience and purpose. In docs/semester-1/geng-300/unit-02/unit-assessment.mdx, no item in the 10 MCQs, 10 RRQs, or 5 ERQs performs this comparison (ERQ 2 presents a single passage on girls education and asks for the four moves of text analysis on that single text). Repair request: rework ERQ 2 (or restructure within the 5-ERQ blueprint) to provide two contrasting passages on the same topic and require learners to compare them for audience and purpose at Analyze or Evaluate level, aligning the rubric accordingly.

RRQ 3 mark scheme arithmetic discrepancy: in docs/semester-1/geng-300/unit-02/unit-assessment.mdx:178-179, RRQ 3 stem header specifies (4 marks), but the mark scheme allocates: Names all four strategies: skimming, scanning, SQ4R, critical reading (1 each up to 4). One mark per correct use case (up to 4). This allocates 8 payable marks against a 4-mark total, so a marker cannot apply the scheme consistently. Repair request: adjust the mark scheme allocation to 1 mark per strategy correctly named with its use case (4 marks total), or raise the question total to 8 marks.

Leaf subtopic U2-05 omitted from prose: specs/content/geng-300/content-spec.md:117 specifies subtopic U2-05 as Reading strategies: making predictions, summarising, questioning. In docs/semester-1/geng-300/unit-02/topic-02.mdx, making predictions is completely omitted from the text (zero occurrences in prose or checks); summarising and questioning are only referenced in passing as steps in SQ4R without explicit instruction on predictive reading strategies. Repair request: add explicit instruction and practice on making predictions before and during reading under ### Reading strategies in topic-02.mdx.

In-text figure references and teacher notes contain cross-reference discrepancies: in topic-02.mdx:78-81, prose refers to The figure above maps common note-taking formats... but the preceding figure is fig-U2-5 (reading strategies table), while note-taking table fig-U2-6 is placed in topic-03.mdx. In topic-03.mdx:56-57, prose refers to The figure above maps the listening process... immediately following fig-U2-6, while the listening process diagram is fig-U2-3 at line 24. Furthermore, unit-teacher-notes.mdx:71-72 incorrectly describes fig-U2-6 as a concept map and fig-U2-3 as a flowchart. Repair request: correct in-text figure references to accurately match placed figures and correct figure archetype labels in teacher notes.

MCQ answer key distribution skew: across the 10 MCQs in unit-assessment.mdx:155-167, correct options are 1 a, 5 b, 4 c, and 0 d. Option d is never the correct key. Repair request: redistribute correct keys across options a-d at next bank revision.

Cosmetic wordmark bounding overlap in fig-U2-5: measure-figure-text.mjs reports shape .panel [14,368,750,456] overlaps with the wordmark box at y=463.3 by 74.3 x 6.5px in fig-U2-5.svg and fig-U2-5.dark.svg.
